The term "Processor" refers to a hardware component or computing element that executes software programs and performs a wide range of computational and operational tasks across various system contexts. As a hardware component, the processor executes applications—such as a recommendation application—and carries out the core operations of a system. In the context of recommendation systems, it is used to determine relationship proximities, rank recommendations, and generate recommendation lists. It also performs computational steps such as clustering and estimating within various methods.

The processor may be a component of a network device, where it is operative to perform actions including first and second pass analyses and purging a classification model. When executing software programs, the processor is operable to perform steps such as receiving, extracting, and storing management data, as well as receiving data-streams, extracting management data, and storing it in a searchable format. In some configurations, the processor is caused by a software program to carry out actions such as receiving, extracting, and storing. It may also be a hardware component that performs the steps of establishing user relationships and executing a filtration method.
